meta.title: Chin Hin Group segment results, Q2 FY2026 and first half
meta.licence: Company disclosure to Bursa Malaysia. Numeric facts recorded with citation; no text of the report is reproduced.
caveats: Segment PBT margin = pbt / revenue. It is a profit-before-tax margin, not a contribution margin.
Segment boundaries may be re-cut by the company between periods; compare like with like.
Net profit attributable to owners (RM7.68m in Q2 FY26 vs RM21.26m) is reported by the press but is not in this file.
